scores.name: Hashiya Folio
scores.note: Margin-note chat is the sharpest interaction idea here, but dense serif text dies on a projector; lead with the plate and red numerals.

scores.name: Gypsum Hour
scores.note: The 2026 warm-editorial default by its own admission; sustainability is one caption line and the look depends on a photo shoot you cannot afford.

scores.name: Lagoon After Dark
scores.note: Off-peak night walking is a real Gulf sustainability lever and poster type projects hard; keep copy civic so magenta never reads nightlife.

scores.name: Girih Screen
scores.note: Lattice-as-mask is clever, but teal, brass and Cormorant is the luxury-Arabian AI palette, and the animated SVG mask will eat your seven hours.

scores.name: Mleiha Field Sheet
scores.note: Carbon ledger is the best theme mechanic in the set, but stamps are badges by another name and MapLibre restyling burns an hour.

scores.name: Coral Reticle
scores.note: Glass panels over a camera feed is exactly what every AI render of an AR tourist app looks like; the carbon row cannot rescue it.

scores.name: Route Band Signage
scores.note: Footprint as route band makes sustainability the information architecture; flat plates build fast and project hard. Warm it with photography or it reads transit.

scores.name: Khor Field Guide
scores.note: Kalba kingfisher and EPAA data are genuinely Sharjah, but sage plus botanical serif is wellness-brand slop and the plates will not finish today.
